brief: Prioritise this unit for pre-event attention and apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure if it cannot be attended before the event [MG-023]. Where a vegetation or obstruction defect is outstanding, clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity [SOP-011]. Reduce permissible load in proportion to the cooling capacity lost and apply ambient de-rating for high temperatures [MG-021].
